**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4329#issuecomment-7216485908

## Scope

- The PR changes tests only: three test files and one golden (`crates/post/tests/golden/wcs_flip/linuxcnc_x.nc`).
- No product code changes. No post script changes. No UI change (the UI file is a test module), so no screenshots are necessary.
- The golden is posted G-code. Thus this review uses the SAFETY tier: two mutations and a line-by-line check of the golden.

## What looks good

- `mirror_trace/mod.rs`: `921, 970` (G92.1, G97) are no-motion codes. G92.1 clears the G92 offsets, and the trace models no G92 offset, so a no-op is correct. G92 itself (920) stays refused. The LinuxCNC post writes these codes at `assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps:434`.
- Golden, line by line: only line 2 changes. The old line was `G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80`. The new line adds `G92.1 G97` at the end. That is the #4196 preamble. All other lines (offsets, arcs, cycles, retracts) are the same.
- `wcs_index.rs` and `setup_wcs_tests.rs` follow #4299: Tormach states 500 offsets, `G54.1 P10` is offset 10, and the fallback name is tested at 501. The setup command bound (`MAX_SLOT + 1 = 255`, `crates/app/src/setup_offsets.rs:31`) is still asserted.
- The body has `Changelog: none (tests only)` and ends with `Fixes #4322`. The commit subject is conventional, and the commit body ends with `Fixes #4322`.

## Results merged with main (locally, macOS, debug)

Trial merge: PR head `3761f682e` + upstream/main `df13bbaf6`. The merge is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post --test wcs_flip_dialects` | 9/9 pass |
| `camcraft-app --test wcs_index` | 4/4 pass |
| `camcraft-ui --lib setup_wcs_tests` | 6/6 pass |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 156 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (6.2 min; includes all post suites, `ui suites: lib`) |
| clippy `-D warnings --all-targets`: post, app, ui | clean |

## Mutations (safety tier)

1. Remove the `921, 970` line from `KNOWN_G`: `wcs_flip_dialects` is red. Three tests fail with `G92.1 is not modelled: G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80 G92.1 G97`. Restored: green.
2. Restore the golden from upstream/main: `flipped_x_goldens_for_the_new_dialects` is red. Restored: green.

## Extra suites run

- Test data: the changed golden directory `golden/wcs_flip` is read only by `crates/post/tests/wcs_flip_dialects.rs`. It ran (9/9).
- Importers: not touched. No kernel suites are necessary.
- `example_catalog`: not necessary. The diff does not touch posts, operations, motion or the catalog.

## Goldens moved

- `crates/post/tests/golden/wcs_flip/linuxcnc_x.nc`, line 2 only. The PR body names it in its table and gives the cause (#4196).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The body has no heading with the name "Goldens moved". It names the golden and its diff in the table, which is sufficient here.
- Follow-up (suggest `P6`, `effort:medium`): the setup command bound (255) is below the 500 offsets that Tormach states. Offsets 256-500 cannot be selected. This is a limit, not a wrong output. The PR body says this too.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
